note: The late of the two shows the Dead played this night. Assembled disc by disc rather than by merge. Road Trips 3:3 spreads this night across four discs — disc one is the early show, discs two and three the late, and the bonus disc carries six more early-show songs plus two late-show ones — so a title-matching merge over the undivided night assigned several timings to the wrong sitting (the early Friend Of The Devil took the late show's 4:06, Cumberland Blues took 5:14, Cold Jordan took 2:33). Every duration here comes from the disc that actually holds that performance. The article's own setlists mark which songs are on the release (*) and which are on the bonus disc (**), and both sittings match those lists exactly. One song needed the tape: Candyman is on neither disc nor bonus disc, and takes 5:51 from gd70-05-15.early-late.sbd.97.sbeok.shnf. Three rows were removed that the skeleton had picked up from the New Riders of the Purple Sage set between the Dead's own — Mama Tried, Me and My Uncle twice — which the article marks as New Riders performances with Bob Weir sitting in. Two songs the tape lacks were added from the release: Deep Elem Blues, which opens the acoustic set, and A Voice from On High, which the taper labels I Hear A Voice Calling.
